description: This file is a C header file defining secure string and memory operation macros, error handling, and related utility functions for safe string operations, primarily wrapping the safeclib library functions. It includes macro definitions, conditional compilation for dummy API, and inline functions for string comparison and memory comparison.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: Inline function to safely format a string with variable arguments, returning success status based on buffer size.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two strings safely, returning a status code and result.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two strings case-insensitively, returning a status code and result.

methods.name: memcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two memory blocks safely, returning a status code and result.
